name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-cdp
description: Safe-by-default MCP that drives an Electron/Chrome app over CDP: DOM, console, network, input.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host serving the DevTools endpoint (default 127.0.0.1; non-loopback needs CDP_ALLOW_REMOTE).

environmentVariables.name: CDP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; interactions need read-write.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_ALLOW_EVAL
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow the evaluate tool (arbitrary JS) — admin mode only. Default false.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_TARGET_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated URL patterns; interactions are confined to matching targets. Empty = all.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set true to log interactions without dispatching them to the browser.
